title: Cigar & Spirit Tasting | Padron
seo_title: Cigar & Spirit Tasting with Padron in Ozark, MO
description: This holiday edition of the Cigar & Spirit Tasting pairs Padron cigars with a lineup of spirits selected for the season, and the event may include a Best Santa Claus Contest with a possible prize, so guests can wear a red suit. Tickets are $65 and reservations are required by calling (417) 882-0399. It takes place Thursday, December 10, 2026 at 6:00 PM at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J, Ozark, MO.
